description: Tailwind CSS gives small classes one clear style job. You combine the classes to make a page. Start with colours and space, then build cards that fit both narrow and wide screens. These examples use Tailwind CSS 4 in a separate project. Install tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/cli. Put @import "tailwindcss"; in input.css and build with npx @tailwindcss/cli -i input.css -o output.css. Link output.css in HTML.
versionNote: Targets Tailwind CSS 4 and its CSS-first theme setup.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to change p-4 to p-8 and compare the inner space
Learn to add one more span and watch how the row changes
Learn to preview the card in light and dark system modes
learningObjectives: Learn to change p-4 to p-8 and compare the inner space
Learn to add one more span and watch how the row changes
Learn to preview the card in light and dark system modes
